matches.preview: Liverpool are favoured to win, with the model assessing a 62% probability. Recent head-to-head meetings between these sides have been tightly contested, and typically low-scoring. Both clubs are returning to action after several months away, their last performances from the end of last season. Nottingham Forest showed stronger finishing form at that point, highlighted by a 5-0 victory away at Sunderland, in contrast to Liverpool's mixed run-in. The model expects an open match, with over 2.5 goals in 59% of outcomes.
matches.preview_zh: Liverpool 被看好獲勝，模型評估勝率為 62%。近期 Liverpool 與對手的交手紀錄一直競爭激烈，通常進球數不多。兩支球隊在離開數個月後回歸，他們的最後表現來自上季尾聲。Nottingham Forest 在那時展現出更強的終段表現，以客場對 Sunderland 的 5-0 勝利為亮點，與 Liverpool 喜憂參半的衝刺形成對比。模型預期會是一場開放的比賽，有 59% 的情況下進球數超過 2.5 球。

matches.preview: Bournemouth start as marginal favourites at 48%, though the model suggests this is far from settled, with Everton at 25% in what looks a competitive encounter. The visitors' recent form offers little encouragement, producing just two draws and four defeats in their final six matches. Bournemouth, meanwhile, have managed a more convincing finish, with wins against Palace and Fulham among their recent results. Most significantly, the head-to-head record has gone decisively Bournemouth's way: four wins in their last five meetings. The total-goals market is nearly split at 51% over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Bournemouth 以48%的微弱優勢開局，儘管模型顯示結果遠未確定，Everton 則占25%，看起來是一場勢均力敵的比賽。客隊近期表現令人失望，最後六場比賽中僅有兩場平局和四場敗績。Bournemouth 則取得更令人信服的收尾，最近的戰績中包括戰勝 Palace 和 Fulham。最重要的是，對戰紀錄明確向 Bournemouth 傾斜，最後五次交手中贏了四場。進球總數市場中，超過2.5球的比例為51%，幾乎對半分。

matches.preview: The model favours Coventry City, rating them at 56 percent to win against Hull City's 20 percent, with draws at 24 percent. Both sides showed strong form at the end of last season: Coventry claimed three wins in four games, while Hull recovered from earlier struggles to beat Norwich in their final fixture. Their recent head-to-head meetings ended in successive goalless draws, suggesting tactical understanding between them. This shapes as a moderately competitive fixture. The model tilts toward over 2.5 goals at 54 percent, though the balance is fairly even.

Tottenham are favoured at 42%, yet with Newcastle at 32% and the draw at 26%, this match shapes as finely balanced. Newcastle arrive with a strong recent record in this fixture, having won four of the last five meetings. Both clubs bring end-of-season form into play: Tottenham finished with mixed results including notable wins over Everton and Aston Villa, while Newcastle's campaign showed inconsistency despite two emphatic home victories against Brighton and West Ham. Over 2.5 goals are forecast at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: Tottenham被看好的概率為42%，Newcastle為32%、平局為26%，這場比賽態勢均衡。Newcastle在此項交手中近期戰績強勢，最近五場交手中勝四場。兩隊都帶著賽季末期的狀態進入比賽：Tottenham收官戰績不穩定，有擊敗Everton和Aston Villa的重要勝績；Newcastle賽季表現缺乏穩定性，儘管主場大勝Brighton和West Ham。超過2.5球的預測概率為57%。

matches.preview: This match is finely balanced, with the model finding little between the sides. Leeds are marginally favoured at 37% compared to Brentford's 36%, with a 27% draw probability. Last season's closing matches showed Leeds with mixed results: home victories over Brighton and Burnley contrasted with a heavy away defeat. Brentford drew frequently against Liverpool and Crystal Palace but took a win at home. Recent head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring, with just two goals across the latest two encounters. The total-goals market is virtually split, with a marginal lean toward over 2.5 at 51%.
matches.preview_zh: 本場比賽勢均力敵，預測模型發現兩隊差距不大。Leeds 勝率為 37%，Brentford 為 36%，平局概率為 27%。上賽季最後幾場比賽中，Leeds 主場擊敗 Brighton 和 Burnley，但客場大敗。Brentford 與 Liverpool 和 Crystal Palace 交手時多次打平，但在主場取勝。最近的頭對頭交手進球數較少，最新兩次交手僅進 2 球。進球數預測幾乎各佔一半，略微傾向於超過 2.5 球，概率為 51%。

matches.preview: The model favours Chelsea at 43 per cent, though Brighton at 30 per cent represents a competitive proposition. End-of-season records show Chelsea produced mixed results with more defeats than victories, including a win over Tottenham, whilst Brighton recorded multiple victories including a 3-0 win over Wolves. Brighton notably defeated Chelsea 3-0 at home in their most recent meeting and hold the clear edge in the overall head-to-head record across recent seasons. The model leans toward over 2.5 goals at 55 per cent.

Fulham are slight favourites at 37% in what the model sees as a closely matched encounter, with Sunderland at 34% and the draw at 29%. Fulham won 3-1 when these teams last met in February and hold a winning record in their recent head-to-head matches. Both sides are returning to this level after their previous season concluded in May; each suffered heavy defeats but also demonstrated capable attacking form in closing matches. The model favours under 2.5 goals at 55%.
matches.preview_zh: Fulham在該模型評估中以37%的概率略微熱門，這場對陣勢均力敵，Sunderland為34%，平手為29%。Fulham在二月上次交手中以3:1勝出，且在最近的交手紀錄中保持勝績。兩隊在上一賽季於五月結束後回到這個級別；各隊都遭遇慘敗，但在收官階段也展現出相當的進攻能力。該模型以55%的概率傾向少於2.5球的結果。

matches.preview: Manchester United are the clear model favourites at 65% for a home victory. The hosts showed considerable strength in their final matches last season, recording five wins from six outings, while Ipswich displayed inconsistency, managing three draws from their final six games alongside only two victories. Their recent head-to-head record is mixed: United won 3-2 in the most recent meeting, though the fixture before that saw a 1-1 draw. The total-goals model leans towards a higher-scoring match, predicting over 2.5 at 60%.
matches.preview_zh: Manchester United 以 65% 的機率成為主場勝利的模型明顯首選。主隊在上賽季最後的比賽中表現出相當的實力，六場中贏得五場；而 Ipswich 則表現不穩定，最後六場比賽中取得三場平手，僅有兩場勝利。他們最近的對戰紀錄參差不齊：United 在最近一次對陣中以 3-2 獲勝，但之前的賽事以 1-1 平手收場。總進球數模型傾向於預測進球較多的比賽，預測 2.5 球以上的機率為 60%。

matches.preview: Arsenal are favoured to win at 49%, though this margin is slim in a finely balanced contest. Draws are assessed at 27% and Aston Villa at 24%. Arsenal finished last season with five successive victories, including a 4-1 win over Aston Villa. Aston Villa showed inconsistency at campaign's end, with losses to Tottenham and Fulham in May and April. The head-to-head record reflects competitive balance. Goals appear likely, with over 2.5 backed at 52% probability against 48% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Arsenal被看好勝出，機率為49%，但在勢均力敵的比賽中，這個優勢並不大。平局評估機率為27%，Aston Villa為24%。Arsenal以五連勝結束上一個賽季，其中包括4:1擊敗Aston Villa。Aston Villa在賽季末期表現不穩定，於5月和4月分別負於Tottenham和Fulham。歷史交戰紀錄反映出雙方實力相當。進球似乎很可能，2.5球以上評估機率為52%，而2.5球以下評估機率為48%。

matches.preview: Liverpool are clear favourites at 57% to win, with Ipswich's chances limited to 19%. The head-to-head between these sides is decisively in Liverpool's favour: they have won both recent meetings comfortably, most recently by 4-1 away. Ipswich's recent form included draws and a loss away from home, while Liverpool finished their campaign with a draw and defeat but showed stronger overall credentials. That historical advantage combined with the model's assessment suggests a contest likely to lean toward over 2.5 goals at 59%.
matches.preview_zh: Liverpool是明確的熱門，勝出機率為57%，Ipswich的勝出機率則限於19%。這兩隊之間的交手紀錄明確對Liverpool有利：他們舒適地贏了最近的兩場對陣，最近一次客場以4-1勝。Ipswich最近的戰績包括平局和客場敗績，而Liverpool則以平局和敗績結束他們的賽季，但展現更強的整體實力。這個歷史優勢加上分析模型的評估表明，比賽進球數超過2.5球的概率為59%。

matches.preview: Newcastle holds a modest edge with the model rating them 43% favourites, though the probabilities suggest this encounter is far from decided. Bournemouth remain strong visitors, having beaten Newcastle 2-1 away in April last season. Newcastle's home form at the end of last season was notably inconsistent, with two 3-1 wins offset by defeats and draws. Bournemouth's recent form shows resilience, with notable draws against strong opposition. The fixture is projected towards goals, with the model favouring over 2.5 at 59%.
matches.preview_zh: Newcastle以模型評分43%被視為預測優勢方，但概率表明這場比賽遠未見分曉。Bournemouth作為客隊表現強勁，上賽季4月曾客場2-1擊敗Newcastle。Newcastle上賽季末的主場表現明顯不穩定，兩場3-1的勝利被敗績和平手所抵消。Bournemouth的近期表現顯示韌性，包括對陣強隊的幾場值得注目的平手。這場比賽預計進球較多，模型傾向於2.5球以上的概率為59%。

matches.preview: Brentford are modelled to win in 54% of simulations, though a draw probability at 25% means this contest remains relatively tight overall. Last season revealed starkly contrasting form between the two sides: Brentford managed just one victory from their final six matches, while Sunderland showed clear improvement with consecutive victories late in the campaign. The head-to-head record from recent meetings favours Brentford. On total goals, the model projects no lean, splitting evenly at 50-50 for over versus under 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Brentford在54%的模擬中獲勝，不過平手機率為25%，代表整體而言這場賽事仍相對膠著。上一個賽季顯示兩隊有明顯的對比表現：Brentford在最後六場比賽中僅贏一場，而Sunderland則在賽季後期連勝，展現明顯進步。近期交手的對戰紀錄對Brentford有利。在總進球數方面，模型未見傾斜，2.5球以上與以下的預測均為50-50。

matches.preview: Brighton are favoured at 55%, with the 25% draw probability reflecting a relatively competitive match-up. Historical form from last season's end was mixed for both teams, with Brighton recording wins over Wolves and Chelsea alongside defeats to Manchester United and Leeds. Most notably, Leeds secured a 1-0 home victory against Brighton in their final meeting of the previous campaign. The total-goals model is finely balanced, showing only a marginal lean towards over 2.5 at 52%, indicating a tightly contested encounter.
matches.preview_zh: Brighton被看好以55%的機率贏球，而25%的平手機率反映出這場對陣相對具競爭性。根據上賽季末的過往戰績，兩隊表現參差不齊，Brighton戰勝了Wolves和Chelsea，但敗給了Manchester United和Leeds。特別值得一提的是，在前一個賽季的最後一次對陣中，Leeds在主場以1比0擊敗Brighton。總進球數模型處於高度均衡的狀態，對於2.5球以上僅呈現輕微傾向，其概率為52%，這表明將是一場勢均力敵的對陣。

matches.preview: Manchester City are strongly favoured at 81% to win at home. These clubs have no previous meetings on record. The hosts' last season comprised consistent results mixed with draws, though it ended with a home defeat to Aston Villa. Coventry City showed strong form at their previous level, with several convincing victories across their final matches. The model anticipates an attacking contest, leaning toward over 2.5 goals at 70%, indicating that both teams should create goal-scoring opportunities in this fixture.
matches.preview_zh: Manchester City被強烈看好在主場獲勝，概率達81%。這兩支球隊過去沒有交手紀錄。Manchester City上個賽季成績穩定，但也有多場平局，賽季末在主場輸給Aston Villa。Coventry City在上一級別的表現強勢，最後幾場比賽取得多場令人信服的勝利。該模型預測這將是一場進攻型比賽，傾向於進球數超過2.5的概率為70%，表示雙方應能創造進球機會。

matches.preview: The model favours Fulham at 43%, a modest edge over Crystal Palace at 30% and a draw at 28%. Fulham showed markedly more consistency through the end of last season than Crystal Palace, who struggled considerably with four losses in their final six matches. However, Palace hold an edge in recent head-to-head meetings, with two victories against one for Fulham and two draws. The expected goals market leans slightly toward under 2.5 at 51%, suggesting a tighter contest may emerge overall.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好Fulham，勝率43%，對Crystal Palace的30%和平局28%略占優勢。Fulham在上賽季末段展現明顯更高的穩定性，相比之下Crystal Palace則困難重重，最後六場比賽中有四場失利。不過Palace在近期交手紀錄中占優勢，對Fulham取得兩勝一負以及兩平。預期進球指標略微傾向低於2.5球，比例為51%，暗示整體比賽可能更加緊湊。

matches.preview: Tottenham start as slight favourites at 39% to Forest's 34%, though a 27% draw probability reflects the tight nature of this encounter. Forest have dominated their recent head-to-head with four consecutive wins, including a 3-0 victory last March, though these results represent history from the previous season. Last term's form showed Tottenham assembling three wins from six games, a steadier return than Forest's mixed finish to the season. The total-goals model leans under at 52%, suggesting a likely low-scoring affair.
matches.preview_zh: Tottenham以39%略佔上風，相對Forest的34%，而27%的和局機率反映出這場比賽勢均力敵的本質。Forest在最近的交手紀錄中佔據優勢，連勝四場，其中包括去年三月的3:0勝利，儘管這些成績代表上賽季的交戰歷史。上賽季的表現顯示Tottenham在六場比賽中取得三勝，表現比Forest賽季末的起伏更為穩定。總進球模型傾向於低分，佔比52%，暗示這可能是場進球較少的比賽。

matches.preview: Aston Villa are clear favourites at 63%, with Hull's win probability just 14%. Hull's last season form was marked by inconsistency: three draws, two defeats and one victory overall, with defensive vulnerabilities apparent. Aston Villa finished powerfully, winning three of their final six matches including a 4-2 home victory over Liverpool and a 2-1 away win against Man City. The model indicates a Villa victory is most likely. Goals trend slightly toward the over, with 55% backing more than 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Aston Villa明顯是熱門，勝率達63%，Hull勝率僅14%。Hull上賽季表現不穩定，共計三場平局、兩場失敗和一場勝利，防守漏洞明顯。Aston Villa末段表現強勁，最後六場中贏得三場，包括主場對Liverpool的4-2勝利和客場對Man City的2-1勝利。模型表明Aston Villa勝利最有可能。進球趨勢略微傾向於多進球，55%的預測支持超過2.5個進球。

matches.preview: Manchester United edge this fixture with 39% to Everton's 33%, though the 28% draw probability suggests it is reasonably well-balanced. United finished last season strongly with five wins from six matches, including a 3-0 victory away at Brighton. Everton, by contrast, struggled through a difficult run of form at the season's end, collecting just two draws from their final six games. United won 1-0 when these sides met in February, with Everton winning 1-0 in their previous encounter. The total-goals market sits at an even split between over and under 2.5, reflecting uncertainty about scoring levels in this encounter.
matches.preview_zh: Manchester United在本場比賽中以39%的勝率佔上風，Everton為33%，不過28%的平手機率顯示這場比賽相當均勻。Manchester United上季末表現強勁，最後六場贏得五勝，其中包括客場對Brighton的3:0勝利。相形之下，Everton在賽季末經歷了一段低迷期，最後六場賽事僅取得兩場平手。Manchester United在二月交手時以1:0勝出，Everton則在之前交手中以1:0獲勝。進球數預測在2.5球以上和以下呈現均勻分佈，反映本場比賽進球數的不確定性。

matches.preview: Arsenal are favoured at 58% in this fixture after winning five of their final six matches last season, with a 3-0 performance prominent among them. Chelsea managed only one win across the same six games, suffering several defeats by significant margins. In head-to-head contests, Arsenal won 2-1 at home in March and have previously triumphed 5-0 and 1-0 on home soil, yet Chelsea have drawn both recent meetings when hosting. The goal market is nearly even at 51% over 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Arsenal在本場被看好，優勢為58%，這是基於球隊在上季最後六場比賽中贏得五場，其中包括一場3-0的勝利。相比之下，Chelsea在同樣的六場比賽中僅贏一場，並遭遇了幾場大敗。在兩隊的直接對賽中，Arsenal曾在三月於主場以2-1獲勝，並有過在主場5-0和1-0的勝績，但Chelsea在主場最近兩次交手都是平局。進球方面，超過2.5球的統計比例為51%，接近平分。
